ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel base with high-intensity (white) localized streaks and circular clusters. Visible surface area estimated at 85% low-intensity and 15% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark field. Linear high-intensity streaks (rake marks) mapped predominantly to the upper-left quadrant. Circular high-intensity rings (rosettes) mapped to the central and right-mid sections of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the fluke center with a narrow acute angle and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge from lobe tips to the median notch. Variations include multiple sharp peaks and semi-circular valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward sweep from the center. The trailing edge follows a complex curve starting as a concave arc near the notch and transitioning to a convex sweep towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct white circular ring structures (barnacle scars) of varying diameters located in the central-right and lower-central region of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the upper-lateral region of the left lobe and distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Living barnacle colonies appearing as highly textured, high-contrast bulbous protrusions attached specifically to the distal tips of both left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of intersecting diagonal white scars on the upper-right distal tip, distinct from the more uniform circular scars elsewhere.
